user.title: QR Guest Access
user.description: Choose the QR reader, the door and, optionally, the camera shown in the panel.

data_description.reader_entity: The image_processing entity created by the QR Code integration (e.g. image_processing.qr_door).
data_description.door_entity: The switch of the Shelly 1 wired to the lock.
data_description.camera_entity: Only used for the preview in the panel.
data_description.open_seconds: How long the relay stays on after a valid QR code.

create_qr.name: Create QR
create_qr.description: Creates a new access QR code. Single-use and valid immediately unless told otherwise.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the QR code, e.g. the guest.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: Start of validity. Empty means now.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: End of validity. Required for unlimited accesses.

max_uses.name: Number of accesses
max_uses.description: How many times it can be used.

unlimited.name: Unlimited accesses
unlimited.description: Ignores the number of accesses; requires an end date.

id.name: ID
id.description: The QR code ID (returned by Create QR).

restore_qr.name: Restore QR
restore_qr.description: Re-enables a revoked QR code. It returns as it was: if it has meanwhile expired or run out, it stays that way.

id.name: ID
id.description: The ID of the revoked QR code.

update_qr.name: Edit QR
update_qr.description: Changes the dates and accesses of a QR code. Empty fields are left unchanged.

uses_left.name: Accesses available
uses_left.description: How many accesses remain from now on.

unlimited.name: Unlimited accesses
unlimited.description: Makes accesses unlimited (requires an end date).

simulate_scan.name: Simulate scan
simulate_scan.description: Runs the same procedure as a camera reading.

code.name: Code
code.description: The text the camera would have read.
